title: tank
description: v0.1 device-model entity: a fluid reservoir monitored by a resistive level sensor. Published under renewvan/tank/<id>/<property>. (v0.1 additions: alarm_state, temperature_c, last_inspected_date)

alarm_state.description: Tank-level alarm state. Direction (low/high) is implicit in per-tank config.

temperature_c.description: Water temperature in degrees Celsius. Present only if a DS18B20 sensor is configured for this tank.

last_inspected_date.description: Most recent tank inspection date (YYYY-MM-DD). Set via /set command topic; republished at startup.
